label: Pipe
description: Real neural voices that run 100% on your PC — no API key, offline, free forever. Powered by Piper. Pick a voice per ducky (or as the default); drop your own .onnx voice models in to add more.

settings.sections.title: Pipe
settings.sections.description: Voices run entirely on this PC — no API key, no per-word cost. The Piper engine and each voice download automatically the first time they're used (needs internet once, then works fully offline). To add your OWN voice, drop a Piper .onnx model plus its .onnx.json next to the downloaded voices (folder path is in the plugin README) and it appears in the picker.

properties.label: Auto-download voices on first use
properties.description: When on, the engine and a voice download automatically the first time you use them. Turn off to only use voices you've already downloaded or added yourself.

steps.title: Pipe voices setup
steps.body: Offline neural voices run on this PC — no API key. Press Pipe to open settings.

steps.title: You're set
steps.body: Voices download on first use. Pick a Pipe voice per ducky (or as the default) in the voice picker.
